method: top-down TAM, bottom-up SAM, SOM 10% of SAM in 3 years

inputs.name: US residents aged 18 to 44
inputs.source: US Census Bureau, Vintage 2025 estimates, Table 1 (census.gov/newsroom/press-releases/2026/vintage-2025-pop-estimates.html)

inputs.name: share who buy entertainment or creator merchandise in a year
inputs.source: assumption: Licensing International puts US/Canada licensed merchandise sales at $227.2B in 2025, about $660 a resident, so one in four adults buying fan merchandise is conservative; replace with a survey

inputs.name: spend a year on fan merchandise
inputs.source: assumption: two artifacts a year at the $26 average price of the 18 items in the JAB Visions Store catalog

inputs.name: fans of independent film, comics and music that Board, THOSE RYDERZ and the founder's New York creator network can reach online
inputs.source: assumption: no audience count exists in the repo yet; 250,000 is the online reach the three-year plan is built to earn, to be replaced with Board sign-ups and social reach once measured

inputs.name: orders a year per customer
inputs.source: assumption: 0.2 orders a customer a month in seed/assumptions.json, 2.4 a year

inputs.name: price per order
inputs.source: average of the 18 artifact prices in the JAB Visions Store catalog (StoreDropMarketplace.tsx, $8.77 to $59.99)

inputs.name: Global sales of licensed merchandise and services, 2025
inputs.source: Licensing International, 2026 Global Licensing Industry Study (licensinginternational.org/get-survey)

inputs.name: Character and entertainment licensed merchandise sales, 2025
inputs.source: Licensing International, 2026 Global Licensing Industry Study (licensinginternational.org/get-survey)

inputs.name: US and Canada licensed merchandise sales, 2025
inputs.source: Licensing International, 2026 Global Licensing Industry Study infographic (licensinginternational.org)

formulas.sam: 250,000 fans of independent film, comics and music that Board, THOSE RYDERZ and the founder's New York creator network can reach online x 2.4 orders a year x $26 = $15,600,000

som_reason: fans who meet THOSE RYDERZ, JAB Lit, Comics and Music on Board buy about two artifacts a year; the model reaches 26,600 paying customers by month 36, won through Board's creator rooms and drops rather than paid ads
